title: GraphACM: Graph-based Action Consistency Measurement for Uncertainty Quantification in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22031v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Behavioral consistency across repeated executions provides an informative signal for assessing the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents. However, existing approaches typically summarize consistency with a single task-level score, without identifying where behavioral differences occur or whether actions are compared under equivalent decision contexts. We propose a graph-based framework for fine-grained behavioral consistency measurement and uncertainty quantification. Given multiple rollouts of the same task, we merge equivalent states into a directed, action-labeled graph, enabling action comparisons at shared decision states. We introduce node-level and global measures of action consistency, using the global consistency score as a proxy for uncertainty to predict task success or failure. translated_title: GraphACM：基于图的动作一致性度量用于大语言模型智能体的不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 跨重复执行的行为一致性为评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体的可靠性提供了有信息量的信号。然而，现有方法通常用单一的任务级分数来概括一致性，既没有识别行为差异发生在哪里，也没有确认动作是否在等价的决策情境下进行比较。我们提出了一个基于图的框架，用于细粒度的行为一致性测量和不确定性量化。给定同一任务的多次执行轨迹，我们将等价状态合并为一个有向的、以动作标注的图，从而能够在共享的决策状态下进行动作比较。我们引入了节点级和全局的动作一致性度量，并将全局一致性分数作为不确定性的代理来预测任务的成功或失败。在ALFWorld、AppWorld和WebShop三个基准上对三个大语言模型的实验表明，我们的度量与任务成功呈正相关。
tldr: 提出GraphACM框架，将同一任务的多次执行轨迹合并为有向动作标注图，在共享决策状态下实现细粒度动作一致性度量，并以全局一致性分数作为不确定性代理来预测LLM智能体任务的成功或失败。
en_tdlr: Proposes GraphACM, a graph-based framework that merges multiple rollouts of the same task into a directed, action-labeled graph, enabling fine-grained behavioral consistency measurement at shared decision states and using the global consistency score as an uncertainty proxy to predict task success or failure in LLM agents.
